decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of 09/02/2019.

Condition : 2 - 1.	The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1422-TP.06 B, 1422-TP.04 A Received 16/12/2015, 1422-TP 02, Flood Risk Assessment, Design and Access Statement - Received 07/10/2015 unless otherwise superseded by Planning Statement, 197-PL-104, 197-PL-105, 197-PL-102, 197-PL-103, 197-PL-106, Unnumbered Location Plan, 197-PL-116 - Received 26/10/2018 and 197-PL-115 Rev A, 197-PL-113 Rev A, 197-PL-112 Rev A, 197-PL-114 Rev A, 197-PL-117 Rev A, 197-PL-118 Rev A - Received 31/10/2018 insofar as the alterations relate to the description of development.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the new unit hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, the front door of the property shall open into the unit, and not out onto the highway.

Condition : 6 - 6.	Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no windows/dormer windows other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed.

Condition : 7 - 7.	The northwest side of the first floor windows to be formed in the west elevation shall be obscured glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 8 - 8.	The first floor window to be formed in the east elevation shall be finished with the details as showing on plan 1422-TP.06 B, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise.
description: Variation of conditions 2 to allow alterations to the front elevation rooflights and internal layout following planning permission 02901/C2/P1dated 9/2/2016 for the erection of a two storey house following the demolition of the existing single storey office building (amended description).
